notes: The floating button now slides out of the way while you scroll down and comes back when you scroll up, so it no longer covers section headings or rows.
Field labels no longer wrap onto a second line and knock the columns beside them out of alignment.
The Log Payment and Add Lump Sum forms now lay out properly on a phone — the account picker no longer cuts off mid-word and the button no longer overlaps the date field.
Rows in Payment Log and Planned Lump Sums now give long account names their own line, so amounts stay aligned and the remove button no longer runs off the edge.
Tidied up the payoff strategy names and several small captions so they read consistently.
